localChanges: Entertainers, Tax Collectors and Scientists in your cities can now be women as well as men, like the citizens beside them (closes #334). Import your assets again to see them.

log: A sprite in `extract-data.json` can now have an `overlay`: rows of palette indices written over it after it's cut out, `..` keeping the original pixel. New sprites can then be made from the player's own `SP257.PIC` while the repo holds only the changed pixels.
`city/people_tax_f`, `city/people_science_f` and `city/people_luxury_f` are the Tax Collector, Scientist and Entertainer as women, drawn like the existing `_f` citizens (civ-clone/web-renderer#334).
